title: Safe Medication Administration Protocol
description: Standard procedure for safe administration of medications following the 5 Rights

steps.details: Use two patient identifiers: full name and date of birth. Ask patient to state their name. Compare with wristband and medication administration record.
Check medication label against MAR three times: when removing from storage, when preparing, and at bedside before administration.
validation_criteria: No signs of contamination or tampering

steps.details: Verify the dose against the order. Calculate dose if needed and have second nurse verify high-risk medications. Use standardized concentration when available.
Confirm the route of administration matches the order. Ensure the medication is appropriate for the specified route.
validation_criteria: Access site verified (IV, PO, IM, etc.)
warnings: Never substitute routes without physician order
Some medications cannot be given by certain routes

steps.details: Administer medication within the facility-approved time window (typically 30-60 minutes of scheduled time). Verify frequency is appropriate.
Explain medication purpose and expected effects. Assess for contraindications, allergies, and vital signs if required. Answer patient questions.
warnings: Do not administer if patient refuses
Hold and notify physician if contraindications present

steps.details: Administer medication using appropriate technique for the route. Follow aseptic technique. Stay with patient for oral medications.
warnings: Do not leave medications at bedside unless ordered

steps.details: Document immediately after administration including time, dose, route, site (if applicable), and patient response. Document any refusal or held medications with reason.

steps.description: Monitor for effects and adverse reactions
steps.details: Monitor patient for therapeutic effect and adverse reactions according to medication profile. Document findings. Report concerns immediately.
warnings: Know common adverse reactions for medications given
Have reversal agents available for high-risk medications

steps.details: Properly dispose of needles in sharps container, dispose of medication vials/ampules per policy, secure controlled substances.

references: Institute for Safe Medication Practices Guidelines
